scenario: Day 26 of a 28-day threshold cycle. The athlete asks 這個週期我有進步嗎？
given: The cycle declared no measurement: goal_context.measurement is null and measurement_evidence is null.
No quality session in the cycle has an attached activity. Every running row after week one reads none_found, which says this build read those days and nothing of that sport attached to the session.
One strength day is on record from the athlete's own report; nothing else came back for the cycle's sessions.
There is therefore neither a declared outcome reading nor two comparable executions to read a direction from.
No per-segment execution is available for the window.

expected.conclusion: Neither question can be answered from this record, and the answer says so for each of them separately rather than as one shrug.
must_state: That no measurement was declared or run, so the outcome is unproven.
That the record holds no comparable executions to read a direction from either — stated as its own finding, not as a consequence of the missing measurement.
That an absent activity is an absence and not a confirmed rest: nothing here establishes that the athlete did not train.
The cheapest thing that would change the answer next time — declaring the measurement, or the athlete saying what actually happened on those days.
must_not_state: That the athlete missed those sessions, or that adherence was poor, from absent activities alone.
That the cycle worked, or that it failed.
A trend read out of prescriptions rather than out of what came back.

fails_if: The answer converts absent activities into missed sessions and reports a compliance problem.
The answer, having been told the two claims are separate, manufactures an execution trend where no session came back.
The answer gives one undifferentiated 'cannot tell' without saying which of the two questions is blocked by what.
